name: ufind.best

sources.title: Listing a tool on ufind.best (plain-text docs for AI agents)

conditions: Free tier joins a queue and is assigned the next open weekly cohort (launch weeks start Monday)
Requires displaying the ufind.best badge on your own site; they check for it, and a listing whose badge disappears is unpublished after 7 days
Free listings get a dofollow link only if the tool finishes in the week's Top 3; all other free listings stay nofollow
Free profile is basic: no AI-written summary, highlights, audiences or FAQ
requirements: An account is required (GitHub, Google, or email registration)
Submissions are reviewed and not all are accepted
Listings run in weekly cohorts starting Monday
preparation: Product name, URL, and basic description
Decide placement for the ufind.best badge on your own site (required for the free tier)
For Premium ($19 one-time): fuller profile assets - summary, highlights, ideal-for audiences, FAQ, full description
workflow: Choose Free (queue + badge) or Premium ($19, choose any open week, permanent dofollow, no badge)
Fill in the listing fields and submit
If free: embed the badge on your site and keep it live; vote performance in your cohort week determines whether the link becomes dofollow
watchFor: Badge is verified continuously - removing it unpublishes the free listing after 7 days
Free listings are nofollow unless the tool reaches Top 3 of its cohort week
Premium ($19) changes placement and page richness but NOT ranking/voting; paying does not improve how the tool is scored
Growth add-on ($6.99/mo) only keeps SEO reports current; it does not affect ranking
There is an MCP server and submit.md aimed at AI agents - the canonical submission page is /submit-a-product
countsAsLive: A public product page on ufind.best visible within your assigned cohort week, votable, and (for paid or Top-3 free listings) carrying a dofollow link.
unknowns: Current queue length / how far out the next free cohort week is
Exact acceptance criteria used in review
